name: Circumflex Booking Meeting Rooms
author: sutregutt

sections.description:
Circumflex Booking Meeting Rooms is a free add-on for Circumflex Booking. It
helps workplaces, coworking spaces and venues let people find and reserve a
room that fits their meeting.

Find the right room

  • Organize rooms by city, building and floor.
  • Add capacity and the facilities that matter at the location, such as video
    conferencing, a whiteboard or step-free access.
  • Let people filter by location, minimum capacity and required facilities.
  • Hide location choices automatically when there is only one relevant option.
  • Show when rooms are busy without publishing meeting subjects, attendees or
    contact details.
  • Keep a browser-local preferred location and favorite rooms on that device.

Choose the time

  • Find rooms for an exact start and end time.
  • Offer useful shortcuts for common meeting lengths while keeping the end time
    editable.
  • Keep start-time intervals and meeting length independent. A booking can, for
    example, last 20 minutes even when available starts are shown every 30
    minutes.
  • Allow full-day and consecutive multi-day reservations when the same room is
    available for the complete period.

Administration and privacy

Administrators can set shared opening hours and narrower hours for a location
or individual room. Each room has one reservation calendar even when it is
offered from several WordPress pages, so it cannot be double-booked.

The add-on uses Circumflex Booking for reservations, manual approval, email,
private customer links and privacy tools. It does not require an account,
license key, external service or Circumflex Booking Pro. A compatible Pro
installation can separately add sign-in, automatic approval, notification
channels and rules that limit who may book.

Privacy

This add-on contacts no external service and stores no telemetry. Circumflex
Booking stores the booking and customer information described in its privacy
section. Preferred location and favorite-room choices are stored only in that
browser; they contain no booking or customer contact data.

Source Code

Source and reproducible build instructions are in the
public GitLab repository.

Support

Use the Support tab for help. Product information and setup documentation are
available at circumflex.no.
Never post booking data, contact details, private booking links or credentials.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Circumflex Booking 1.6.0 or newer.
  2. Install and activate Circumflex Booking Meeting Rooms.
  3. Open Booking > Settings and select Meeting rooms as the site’s booking
    setup.
  4. Open Booking > Rooms and save the first room. An empty setup creates the
    standard room-booking type in the same operation.
  5. Add capacity, location and facilities where useful, then review shared or
    room-specific booking hours.
  6. Add the Circumflex Booking block or shortcode to a normal WordPress page and
    complete a test booking before opening it to users.

Only one public booking setup is active on a site at a time. Installing this
add-on does not select it, create sample data or alter existing bookings.
sections.faq:
Can I use the add-on without Circumflex Booking Pro?

Yes. Room discovery, exact-time booking, reservations, manual approval, email
and private customer links use the free Circumflex Booking plugin.

Are existing meeting details shown in room timelines?

No. Public availability can show that a period conflicts, but does not publish
meeting subjects, attendees, contact details, notes or internal identifiers.

Can several room-booking pages share the same room?

Yes. A room keeps one authoritative reservation calendar. Different public
entrances may preselect locations or filters, but cannot double-book the room.

Does activating the add-on change existing bookings?

No. Activation only makes Meeting rooms available under Booking > Settings. An
administrator must choose it explicitly. Existing Circumflex Booking settings
and bookings are kept.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Lead with how people find a suitable room by place, time, capacity and
    facilities.
  • Replace development terminology in the public plugin information with clear
    meeting-room language.
  • Include a maintained Norwegian Bokmal translation for add-on notices and
    verify Meeting Rooms wording across the free and optional Pro screens.

1.0.0

  • First stable Meeting Rooms release with locations, capacity, facilities and
    shared or room-specific booking hours.
  • Add exact start and end times, useful meeting-length shortcuts and room
    availability without exposing details about other meetings.
  • Add optional browser-local preferred location and favorites. Compatible
    sign-in can provide saved contact details and a personal list of bookings.

0.2.0

  • Create the standard room-booking type when the first room is saved.
  • Add relevant duration settings, optional room contacts, capacity and location.
  • Preserve existing settings and booking history during the upgrade.

0.1.1

  • Use consistent room, booking-duration and room-contact wording throughout the
    free and optional Pro screens.
  • Preserve saved names, custom email templates and other booking setups.

0.1.0

  • Initial separately installed Meeting Rooms add-on with account-free booking
    and meeting-room email templates.
